# `company.inventory_count_lines`

Lines of a physical count: one per item and place; the counted quantity is fixed when recorded.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this count line. |
| `count_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with count_id + item_id + place_key, unique with count_id + position | ix_inventory_count_lines_item | inventory_counts.id | Count this line belongs to. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with count_id + position | — | — | One-based position on the sheet. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with count_id + item_id + place_key | ix_inventory_count_lines_item | items.id | Item counted. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin counted; null for no bin. |
| `lot_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | lots.id | Lot counted; null when unassigned. |
| `serial_number_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | serial_numbers.id | Serial number counted; null when unassigned. |
| `place_key` | VARCHAR(80) | no | — | unique with count_id + item_id + place_key | — | — | Bin, lot and serial number ids joined by "\|" (empty for none); one line per item and place. |
| `origin` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | sheet (the books held it, or it was named) or found (entered for a place not on the sheet). |
| `counted_microunits` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Counted quantity in base micro-units, fixed when the count is recorded; null before, and on a line nobody counted. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this count line was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this count line. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this count line. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this count line. |
